comments.author: yuri
comments.text: VERIFIED PASS: e2e real. tests/e2e.test.ts boots full hub_local composition (json_store/jsonl_store/memory_bus/attention store/watcher/unix_socket) over temp root + real unix socket; two fake peers speak docs/02 frames (hello handshake, report, cmd/reply, deliver); fakes only at AgentRuntime spawn boundary. 56 assertions traced against docs/01 Testing + docs/02 frame shapes: session_start upsert both peers (kind/status/phase/model/title/log/toolCounts/turns), hues, send command both directions with sessionId-addressed routing, durable logs (system/prompt/message lines), title fill, tool_call raises approval AttentionItem + waiting phase + toolCounts, attention list, answer resolves (resolvedAt/answer, deliver to peer, phase back to working), kind:resolution line in summaries.jsonl (by:cli, exact text), docs/02 envelopes for not-yet-served tool (denied) + worker-only kill (unknown-session), list snapshot shape, status.json read from disk (version/pid/sessions/final state, no .tmp). Relay legs for future tool round-trip exercised via send/deliver/report/reply path. Stability: e2e 5/5 green, workspace 646 pass 0 fail x2, tsc --noEmit exit 0. Mutation probes: (b) sessionId-routing broken (first-reporter-wins) -> e2e fails (bravo deliver timeout) — routing assertion is real. (a) atomic-write -> direct write: e2e does NOT catch it — no-tmp + disk-read assertions pass trivially; atomicity guarded at adapter level (json_store.test.ts interrupted-write + rename tests, still green under mutation). Follow-up candidate: e2e could assert serialized meta-block version-first invariant, but adapter coverage sufficient. Scope clean: tests/e2e.test.ts + tracker only, source untouched post-restore.
